items.title: Actual truncated matrix means in the Gaussian column experiment

source.anchor: Appendix C.2 p12.4 actual matrix means, Ex107/108 and Ex110 two mean sums; original p1 experiment, p10 cutoff and Fact C.5 feature sums
source.attribution: On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling, arXiv:2610.20492v1.
source.scope: Concrete original column-product realization; actual integrable matrix and sum means. No ambient transfer or concentration result.

items.statement: Every actual truncated matrix is integrable and has the exact common-coefficient mean. The private consumer proves the expectations of the actual unweighted and cosine-weighted sums.

formulae.label: Actual individual matrix means
formulae.tex: Y_i\in L^1(\mu),\qquad \mathbb E_\mu Y_i=\frac ad\bigl(I_r\otimes t_it_i^\top\bigr).

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), and \(r=q+1\). Thus \(d\ge2\), \(r\ge1\), and \(q=0\) is retained.

The original outcome space is \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), with the literal product \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The actual row is \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\). No row law or mean is supplied by the caller.

Put \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\), \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i[0]=1\), and \(t_i[k]=\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i)\) for \(1\le k\le q\). The source physical index is \(i.val+1\); feature indices remain \(k.val\).

The common scalar is fixed by \(a=r^{-1}\int_{\mathbb R^r}\|x\|^2\mathbf1_{\{\|x\|^2\le L\}}\,d\gamma_r(x)\). Its retained-radius integrability belongs to the reused canonical moment proof. The actual row law identifies this same scalar in every physical row; no free per-row coefficient is introduced.

The displayed \(Y_i\) uses its own inclusive local cutoff, inverse-\(d\) scaling, and Gaussian-first paired indices in the Kronecker product. It is an unconditional truncated matrix on the same original \(\mu\); the law is not conditioned on all rows passing.

Matrix expectations are complete Bochner integrals in the actual finite-dimensional Euclidean operator norm. Integrability of every \(Y_i\) and of both actual sums is proved. The source displays sums of expectations; finite integrability and integral exchange internally give the displayed actual-sum expectations. No independence, Gram, moment, integrability, mean, \(\tau\), or condition-number certificate is a premise.

obligations.label: Actual Yi integrability and means with a real two-sum expectation consumer.

bindings.boundary: This local producer proves only actual original-experiment truncated matrix integrability and first moments. Its private consumer proves integrability and expectations of both actual finite sums. The same canonical row-law, truncated-row moment and cosine-frame nodes are reused; no second public radial/marginal lemma is created. The old private canonical-row matrix application remains immutable history and gains no duplicate public credit. Arbitrary extended-ambient transfer, scalar bias/range extensions, public aggregate canonicalization, centered variance, matrix concentration, full Lemma4.4, both main lower bounds and exact oracle/TV/precision/worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters remain open. Serialized integration, actual desktop/mobile/MathJax/source-index/globalgraph/copy/download/public delivery and purification remain open.

assumption_deltas.source: Original r=q+1 independent standard d-Gaussian columns, q>=0 and2q+1<d.
assumption_deltas.lean: Fixed canonical product experiment, actual row coordinates, q=0 and exact half-grid/cutoff retained.
assumption_deltas.reason: Concrete realization only; no ambient transfer, independence or row-law certificate input.

assumption_deltas.source: The same a=(1/r)E[Ri indicator(Ri<=L)] occurs in every actual Yi mean.
assumption_deltas.lean: a is defined by the canonical retained radial integral; actual row transport and the existing canonical radial moment derive all exact actual matrix means.
assumption_deltas.reason: The common law identifies the scalar internally. No free per-row mean or new public radial lemma is introduced.

assumption_deltas.source: Ex110 displays both sums of expectations and p12.5 states the weighted sum has zero expectation.
assumption_deltas.lean: The real private consumer proves integrability and Bochner integrals of both actual random sums.
assumption_deltas.reason: Finite integrability, matrix norm/completeness and finite integral/scalar exchange are proved internally; they are output obligations, not added hypotheses.
